points.today: Today's amount: one number that tells you how much you can spend today, until the next transfer from home.
points.wallets: Your wallets, by hand: cash, D17, Flouci or bank card. Mizania never connects to them and never moves money.
points.languages: Free, in Tunisian Arabic, French or English. Install it on your phone like an app.
